meta.name: understand-chat
meta.description: Use when you need to ask questions about a codebase or understand code using a knowledge graph

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用知识图谱问答代码库，快速理解代码结构
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速理解陌生代码库的结构和逻辑
copy.tagline_en: Query codebase with knowledge graph to understand code quickly
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly understand the structure and logic of an unfamiliar codebase

howto.what: 装好后,Claude 会用项目里的知识图谱文件回答代码库问题:先查项目信息,再按关键词搜索节点、连接关系和分层,最后给出指向具体文件/函数的答案。
howto.when: 当你提出关于当前代码库的问题,且项目里有 `.understand-anything/knowledge-graph.json` 时触发;若没有该文件,会提示先运行 `/understand`。

say.text: 这个函数被哪些地方调用了?
say.note: 会沿 calls/imports 边查上游引用。
读取 layers 和节点归属来回答。
按 depends_on/imports 关系列出下游依赖。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude answers codebase questions using the project's knowledge graph file: it first reads project metadata, then searches relevant nodes, edges, and layers by keyword, and finally gives answers pointing to specific files/functions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about the current codebase and `.understand-anything/knowledge-graph.json` exists; if absent, it asks you to run `/understand` first.

say_en.note: Traces upstream references via calls/imports edges.

say_en.text: What layers is the project architecture split into?
What files does this module depend on?
